summary.text: William Lamberth is a Republican member of the Tennessee House of Representatives for District 44, where he has served since 2012, and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
In the general election, Lamberth is on the ballot with Latoya Holcomb.
Ballotpedia's list of current members names him House Majority Leader.

paragraphs.text: William Lamberth was first elected to the Tennessee House of Representatives for District 44 in 2012.
In the 2023–2024 session he chaired the House Rules Committee and was also assigned to the Calendar and Rules, Civil Justice, Criminal Justice, House Ethics, and Finance, Ways, and Means committees.
In 2012, Ballotpedia reports, Lamberth stated that he believes "in low taxes, small government, and traditional family values."
